plan.title: M5Stack M5GO IoT Kit v2.7 · K006-V27
plan.summary: ESP32物联网教学套装，主机带2英寸屏、三按键、MPU6886和500mAh电池，附六种Unit等配件。
plan.assemblyNotes: Selected manufacturer components retain their native assembled relationship; one common rigid transform only. Omitted components are separately recorded. No nonuniform scale or geometry fitting.
